variables.var: Description of the project or initiative

step.name: extract_context_and_risks
step.system: You are a risk analysis expert. Identify {{numberOfRisks}} key risks for the project.

step.name: assess_risks
step.system: You analyze individual risks and assess their impact and probability.
step.response_schema:
class RiskProfile(BaseModel): name: str probability: int impact: int description: str
class RiskAssessment(BaseModel): profiles: list[RiskProfile]

step.name: map_risks
step.system: You classify risks into strategic groups based on probability and impact.
step.prompt:
Classify risks into 4 groups: - Critical (high probability, high impact) - High (high probability OR high impact) - Medium (medium probability and impact) - Low (low probability and impact)
Risks: {{risks}} Assessment: {{risk_assessment}}
step.response_schema:
class RiskGroup(BaseModel): name: str risks: list[str] strategy: str
class RiskMapping(BaseModel): critical: RiskGroup high: RiskGroup medium: RiskGroup low: RiskGroup

step.name: develop_mitigation
step.system: You develop mitigation tactics for each risk group.
step.response_schema:
class MitigationPlan(BaseModel): group_name: str approach: str prevention: list[str] response: str responsible: str
class MitigationStrategy(BaseModel): plans: list[MitigationPlan]
